description: This file implements JWT token handling and authentication logic for a proxy server, supporting JWT validation, role mapping, scope enforcement, user and team object retrievals, and integration with external authentication providers such as OpenID Connect. It defines classes like JWTHandler and JWTAuthManager that handle token validation, role-based access control, and user-team synchronization.

classes.name: JWTHandler
classes.description: Handles JWT token validation, extraction of claims, role mapping, key management, and fetching user information from OIDC providers.

classes.name: JWTAuthManager
classes.description: Provides static methods for role-based access control, scope validation, user and team object retrieval, and authentication building logic.
